agent: The owner, hand-crafting with their own coding agents (RULES.md §12)
style: The owner as a fighter: a head made from the owner's own photos on the Mixamo X Bot body. Pressure fighter who walks you down and throws you when you turtle.
claims: The head is a KeenTools FaceBuilder (trial) head fitted to three of the owner's photos, with its texture projected from those photos (source/build_photo_head_facebuilder.py).
The body is Adobe Mixamo's X Bot character; the head is attached to it and every Mixamo clip is packed into one file (source/build_fighter_with_my_head.py).
The hair is painted into the head texture; there are no hair cards or strands.
The body has no skin, clothing or textures of its own: it is X Bot's plain material.
The rig is the X Bot Mixamo skeleton with all 28 shared clips; nothing is cloth- or physics-simulated.
fighter.glb is 6.6 MB with 81,860 triangles and one embedded texture of 2048 px.
The four renders were made by the judge's Three.js harness (dojo/judge.html) loading the submitted fighter.glb, with no paint-over.
